column1: # blocco-d.doctor.tsv — the messages of maat-doctor.sh (block D, lane 1a), read by tools/lingua-converti.py.
# key <TAB> at <TAB> pre <TAB> post <TAB> names <TAB> en (format: the docstring of lingua-converti.py). Section
# maat-doctor. The bash part is replaced by `apply`; the Python program after #__PYTHON__ (!pytail rows) was edited by
# hand (T of maat_msg). Frozen in every language (D3): the tokens OK|ATTENZIONE|MANCA and the meta lines #chiave<TAB>
# valore between the Python part and bash; the bash `riga` maps the level only when printing (level_* below). Frozen
# too: the --piattaforma values (windows-wsl, windows-senza-wsl, altro, read by /maat:setup) and the maat.json keys.
